class.name: OcgAISAxis
class.brief_description: Locates the x, y and z axes in an Interactive Object. These are used to orient it correctly in presentations from different viewpoints, or to construct a revolved shape, for example, from one of the axes. Conversely, an axis can be created to build a revolved shape and then situated relative to one of the axes of the view.
class.description: ! Locates the x, y and z axes in an Interactive Object. ! These are used to orient it correctly in presentations ! from different viewpoints, or to construct a revolved ! shape, for example, from one of the axes. Conversely, ! an axis can be created to build a revolved shape and ! then situated relative to one of the axes of the view.

method.name: from_3
method.description: initializes the axis2 position aComponent. The coordinate system used is right-handed.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Initializes the ray as axis with start point and direction

method.name: Component
method.description: Returns the axis entity aComponent and identifies it as a component of a shape.

method.name: SetComponent
method.description: Sets the coordinates of the lin aComponent.

method.name: Axis2Placement
method.description: Returns the position of axis2 and positions it by identifying it as the x, y, or z axis and giving its direction in 3D space. The coordinate system used is right-handed.

method.name: SetAxis2Placement
method.description: Allows you to provide settings for aComponent:the position and direction of an axis in 3D space. The coordinate system used is right-handed.

method.name: SetAxis1Placement
method.description: Constructs a new line to serve as the axis anAxis in 3D space.

method.name: SetTypeOfAxis
method.description: Constructs the entity theTypeAxis to stock information concerning type of axis.

method.name: IsXYZAxis
method.description: Returns a signature of 2 for axis datums. When you activate mode 2 by a signature, you pick AIS objects of type AIS_Axis.

method.name: AcceptDisplayMode
method.description: Returns true if the interactive object accepts the display mode aMode.
